title: T2 Topologies fail Everflow tests with "UnboundLocalError: local variable 'duthost' referenced before assignment"
author: arista-nwolfe
body:
All T2 topologies fail all Everflow tests due to:
`UnboundLocalError: local variable 'duthost' referenced before assignment`

This occurs on the following line:
`setup_information = gen_setup_information(duthost, downstream_duthost, upstream_duthost, tbinfo, topo_scenario)`

This is because we don't assign the `duthost` variable on t2 topologies:
```
if 't1' in topo or 't0' in topo or 'm0' in topo or 'mx' in topo or 'dualtor' in topo:
    downstream_duthost = upstream_duthost = duthost = duthosts[rand_one_dut_hostname]
elif 't2' in topo:
    pytest_assert(len(duthosts) > 1, "Test must run on whole chassis")
    downstream_duthost, upstream_duthost = get_t2_duthost(duthosts, tbinfo)
```

This was introduced in the following PR:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/9414
